subject: Travel request pending final details
text: I am writing because your conference travel request is still pending after my last note. I checked the campus portal and found that the airfare quote has been saved, but the accommodation form remains open, which prevents the booking office from issuing tickets. I need you to confirm the arrival window, decide whether you prefer the hotel attached to the venue or the alternate hotel two blocks away, and upload the approved departmental charge code. I also need to know whether you want a ground transfer from the airport and whether any accessibility accommodations should be recorded in the reservation notes. If you can provide those details by Thursday afternoon, I can hold the current fare and submit the package before the deadline on Friday. If not, the quote will expire, and I will have to compare new prices, which may increase the total cost and delay the visa invitation letter. Please reply with the missing information in one message, and mention the title of the panel you are chairing so the registration can be aligned with the travel file. I can send the remaining forms again, but it will be faster if you use the secure upload link I referenced in the earlier thread. Until these items are closed, the trip is not considered complete, and I cannot send a confirmation to the host institution. I appreciate your quick attention, and I am available to adjust the itinerary if your schedule changes. Send any updates before my morning check.
